title: MoreGlowQoL
description: Make signs glow with glow berries, glowstone, or ink sacs, then extract the glow with a brush for random rewards.
body: MoreGlow is a Paper plugin that adds customizable glowing signs to Minecraft servers. Use glow berries, glowstone dust, or glow ink sacs to apply glowing effects to signs. Use a brush to extract the glow and receive random rewards. Features anti-farming protection, full configuration support, and persistent data storage. Perfect for servers looking to add visual depth and gameplay mechanics to sign decoration!
